observations: Seller insists it was tested and that all claims are true, but provides no new photos/videos.
The original photos still do not show a clearly readable transmission ID/part-number plate or any diagnostic/test evidence.

claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not show a readable Jeep/Wrangler/3.6L year compatibility label or transmission ID plate.
Photos do not clearly show the transfer case/low-range unit or a readable spec confirming 'low' range configuration.
No paperwork, shipping label, or readable import markings shown in photos.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Seller text only; no test video/diagnostic report and no photo evidence confirming 'never opened' or 'no knock'.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission variant for the exact Wrangler 3.6L year/4x4 configuration (different internal specs/gear ratios/connector types).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the transmission identification plate/label (with part number/serial) plus a photo of the connector/plug type on the transmission harness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the worst-case mismatch risk: treated as not guaranteed to fit and not guaranteed to work until verified.

risks.risk: Not actually working (could have internal damage, delayed engagement, or solenoid/torque-converter issues).
risks.proof: Short video of the transmission being run/tested showing engagement through gears and no abnormal noises.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs overhaul until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Transfer case / low-range components may be missing, damaged, or not included (seller may be describing more than what is pictured).
risks.proof: Photo showing exactly what is included laid out (transfer case, output shafts, sensors) with a checklist, and close-ups of any part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gearbox only (or incomplete kit) until inclusion is confirmed.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in these angles: leaks, cracked housings, damaged mounts, or stripped sensor ports.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams/gaskets, drain/plug areas, sensor ports, and any visible cracks/repairs; plus underside shots.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential leaks/repairs needed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the transmission ID plate/label (part number + serial) on the casing.
Photo of the transmission connector/plug(s) and any external sensor locations to confirm variant.
Video proof of testing/operation (or diagnostic report) showing engagement through gears and no abnormal noise.
Photos showing exactly what parts are included (especially transfer case/low-range components) and any part numbers on included units.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by new remote evidence. The key items needed to price safely—readable transmission ID/variant and proof of testing—are still missing from the photos.
